about: USDA FoodData Central, FNDDS 2021-2023 survey foods (October 2024, public domain): the description of every survey entry our food list cites, by FDC id, and what USDA makes it from, as its input_food.csv lists them: each ingredient's description and its SR Legacy food group, empty where the ingredient is not in that release. An ingredient that is itself a survey food is read down to its own ingredients. Written by tools/check-food-sources.ts --write-groups, which also fails when this file differs from the download; never edited by hand.
